headline: Bunting averages 106 in final to win Premier League Night 16
standfirst: Stephen Bunting beat Luke Humphries 6-3 in the final at Sheffield's Utilita Arena, finishing the night with a 106.37 average.
body: Stephen Bunting took the honours on the final league night of the 2026 Premier League, beating Luke Humphries 6-3 in the final at the Utilita Arena in Sheffield. Bunting saved his best for last, averaging 106.37 in the final against Humphries' 102.23.

His route to the trophy was a demanding one. He came through a high-quality quarter-final against Jonny Clayton 6-3, despite Clayton averaging 104.90, and then beat Gerwyn Price 6-3 in the semi-finals. A 161 checkout in that semi-final was the highest finish of the night.

Humphries had needed a deciding leg to edge Michael van Gerwen 6-5 in their quarter-final, in a match where each player averaged over 100, before beating Luke Littler 6-1 in the other semi-final. Littler had scraped past Josh Rock 6-5 in his opener.
Price produced the best quarter-final average, 105.97, in his 6-2 win over Gian van Veen.
Bunting led the 180 count with 13 of the night's 46 maximums. Humphries hit nine and Price six.
With the league phase complete, attention turned to the play-offs at The O2 in London the following week.
